New Lead Routing
New leads and projects are assigned to this designer as their account owner by default.
Google Maps
Paste your Google Maps API key to turn on address autocomplete. The key is locked to app.spegiti.com.
Job Costing
Default shop labor rate ($/hr, wages + burden), used with clocked hours for job margins. Override per person on their employee card.
$ / hr
QuickBooks Online
Push invoices & payments to QuickBooks so nobody double-enters. Paste the Client ID from your Intuit developer app, then Connect.
Automated Emails
Four reminders go out on their own: overdue invoices (every 7 days), designs waiting on approval past 3 days (every 5 days), install-day heads-ups the day before, and an instant reply to new leads who left an email. Preview first — nothing sends until you say so.
Where shop notifications land when no project manager is assigned:
Features
The core loop — jobs, quotes, drawings & approvals, the Shop List, invoicing — is always on. Switch on the rest as your shop grows into it. Turning a group off just hides it; nothing is deleted.
Pipeline Stages
Name the steps a job moves through — add stages like Drawing, Measure Scheduled, or On Hold, rename or reorder them. Each stage belongs to a phase (what the colors, reports, and customer portal understand). Renames carry existing projects along automatically.
Cloud Backup (Google Drive)
Every night the full database is exported to a dated folder in your Google Drive — Spegiti Backups/spegiti-backup-YYYY-MM-DD — one CSV per table, openable in Access, Excel, or Sheets. Connect the account that should hold the backups (e.g. admin@spegiti.com).
Google Calendar Sync
Connect once to auto-push installs & appointments to your Google Calendar — no popup each time.
